title: Include the ability to specify pass file location
line: The Pass widget's settings now have a General page where you can choose which password store folder it shows.
explanation: The Pass widget always read the store from $PASSWORD_STORE_DIR or ~/.password-store, and had no settings page at all, so using a store elsewhere meant changing the whole session's environment. The change adds a General settings page with a folder field and a folder picker; the model gains a passwordStoreDirectory property (empty keeps the old behaviour, ~ is expanded) and reloads the list and its file watcher when it changes.

commits.message:
config: add a setting for the password store location

The widget could only read the store from $PASSWORD_STORE_DIR or
~/.password-store, so using another folder meant changing the session's
environment. Add a General page to choose it, and reload the list live.

BUG: 522100

media.caption: The widget can only show the default store (~/.password-store).
After choosing ~/work-store in the settings, the widget lists that store right away.
Settings only have Keyboard Shortcuts and About; no way to pick the store.
New General page with a password store location field and folder picker.

review.text: Adding a passwordStoreDirectory property to the model and a General config page is the right place and keeps the env/default fallback; providers decrypt by absolute path so it works for any folder. But the folder picker converts the URL with a regex on selectedFolder.toString(), which keeps percent-encoding, so a folder with spaces or non-ASCII characters is saved as e.g. 'My%20Store' and won't be found; currentFolder is likewise built by string concatenation.
changes: Convert FolderDialog URLs properly (e.g. decodeURIComponent on the path or a urlToLocalFile helper) and build currentFolder with a proper file URL.
Optionally avoid the double populate() (constructor plus the first property set from QML).
